prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single character turnaround sprite sheet for a gothic RPG, Castlevania and Ragnarok Online inspired, richly detailed 32-bit-era pixel art. The same original main character in every view: wild flame-red hair, youthful fantasy adventurer, dark fitted coat with burgundy lining, worn leather boots, silver armor accents, small cross-body satchel, distinctive teal gem and a sheathed slender sword. Show exactly eight separate full-body idle sprites, each appearing ONCE, ordered left to right then top to bottom on a strict 4 columns by 2 rows grid: south, southwest, west, northwest, north, northeast, east, southeast. Exact same design, scale and neutral standing pose in all views, clearly distinguish directions, no overlaps, all feet aligned per row, ample transparent space between figures. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, muted wine red, charcoal, teal and old silver, straight-on orthographic sprite views, no scenery, no shadows beneath, no borders, no text, no labels, no extra sprites. Transparent background.
